# Dasiel Torres — Full-Stack Software Engineer

> Portfolio of Dasiel Torres, a Full-Stack Software Engineer based in Cuba and working remotely. Professional work since 2023 across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, integrations, payments and fintech. Most recent work: the Supernova payment gateway, ACR Pay, ACR Card and the ACR Card app.

The site is available in English and Spanish with equivalent content. Every statement here is taken from the site itself.

## Pages
- [Home (English)](https://dasiel.vercel.app/en): profile, selected work, anatomy of a product, path, lab, contact.
- [Inicio (Español)](https://dasiel.vercel.app/es): the same content in Spanish.

## Selected work
- [ACR Card](https://dasiel.vercel.app/en/work/acr-card): platform to request Visa and Mastercard cards.
- [ACR Card App](https://dasiel.vercel.app/en/work/acr-card-app): platform to manage ACR cards, review transactions and transfer between cards.
- [Supernova Payment Gateway](https://dasiel.vercel.app/en/work/supernova-gateway): payment gateway with bank and financial-service integrations.
- [ACR Pay](https://dasiel.vercel.app/en/work/acr-pay): platform to top up classic cards and mobile phones in Cuba.

## Earlier work
- [Gym Victoria](https://dasiel.vercel.app/en/work/gym-victoria): multi-tenant gym management SaaS (freelance, 2024).
- [MK Tattoo Supply](https://dasiel.vercel.app/en/work/mk-tattoo-supply): e-commerce platform with live inventory and payments (freelance, 2023–2024).

## Other
- Education: B.Eng. in Computer Science, Universidad de Ciencias Informáticas (UCI), Havana (2018–2023).
